When building multiple test packages, `go test` command will add `-s -w` which discards the symbol table (debug info for ELF).
It's hard coded and there is no way to control the behavior:
https://github.com/golang/go/blob/eee6f9f825596a769ff163e098d2656cbed09d4f/src/cmd/go/internal/test/test.go#L1042


I use another way to generate the test binary with debug info
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/33368/files

But it turned out useless ... even with the panic stack info, I can't figure out why it panics.
So now I prefer a workaround for it https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/33566
